hero.title: Undergraduate Mechanical Engineering in Australia
hero.subtitle: Mechanical engineering is one of the oldest and broadest engineering disciplines. It focuses on the design, analysis, testing, manufacturing, and maintenance of mechanical systems, machines, and thermal devices.

overview: Undergraduate mechanical engineering programs in Australia emphasize mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, robotics, materials science, CAD modeling, and sustainable industrial manufacturing.

faq.question: After Class 12, are Indian students able to pursue Mechanical Engineering in Australia?
faq.answer: Indeed. Students that fulfill the academic, math, science, and English language requirements of the university are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Does Mechanical Engineering require mathematics?
faq.answer: Mathematics is a core prerequisite. Physics and chemistry are also highly recommended for admission.

faq.question: What is the duration of an Australian Mechanical Engineering degree?
faq.answer: A standard Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) requires four years of full-time study.

faq.question: How much does mechanical engineering tuition cost?
faq.answer: Annual international tuition generally ranges between AUD 38,000 and AUD 55,000, depending on the institution.

faq.question: Edu Hawk can help Indian students who want to study mechanical engineering in Australia.
faq.answer: Edu Hawk Worldwide provides end-to-end guidance including university selection, application processing, scholarship assistance, and student visa application.
